newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PG BUYS PILKINGTON GLASS UNIT.
newsitem.headline: PG BUYS PILKINGTON GLASS UNIT.

text.p: South African Plate Glass and Shatterprufe Industries Ltd announced on Wednesday its Belron International division would acquire Canadian Standard Auto Glass from Pilkington Plc for 120 million rand.
Standard Auto Glass is a leading Canadian retail automotive glass business. Belron International is the PG Group's global automotive glass repair and replacement network.
Belron has more than 1,000 branches in 13 countries.

PG chairman Ronnie Lubner said the acquisition offered Belron the opportunity to acquire a significant share of the well-developed Canadian market and to consolidate Belron's business in the North American region.
"As Belron develops a meaningful presence in each country, it makes good sense, both strategically and in terms of economy of scale, to expand into contiguous markets.
"In this way we can maximise potential synergies in terms of, for example, marketing, toll-free call centres and relationships with the major insurers and fleet owners," PG said in a statement.
In the year ended March 31, Belron's sales were more than one billion dollars and contributed 68 percent to the PG group's turnover of 6.6 billion rand.
The transaction will be funded by Belron's own resources.
"While the transaction will certainly have some impact on the profitability of Belron in the current year, it is unlikely to have a material effect on PG's earnings," Lubner said.
